_comment: Copy to appsettings.Production.json ON THE PI (it is gitignored and must never be committed), fill in the real values, chmod 600.

Scraper._HotBurnWindowSafetyFraction: Revisit a card selling >= HotRateThreshold/day after this much of its burn window. Absorbs an acceleration of up to 1/fraction between visits: 0.4 covers 2.5x. Turn it DOWN if a card loses sales to a burst again — 0.33 covers 3x for ~150 more visits/day, 0.25 covers 4x for ~430 more, against a ~8470/day ceiling. Restart the service to apply.
Scraper._NearMissMargin: Rows of overlap at or below which a visit logs a near miss and counts on crawl.bucket_near_miss. Zero overlap is not a near miss but an actual loss, alerted separately.
